buttercup-beauty.shortDescription: A spacious Wildwood Crest gathering place with a heated pool, hot tub, and room for the whole family.
buttercup-beauty.fullDescription: Buttercup Beauty is a generous shore home designed around time together. Its open living spaces, game room, and fenced backyard make it especially well suited to multigenerational groups and friends traveling with dogs.
uniqueFeatures: Approximately 3,200 square feet of interior space
Heated private pool and eight-person hot tub
Game room, covered dining area, and bakery directly across the street

designerNote.headline: Three generations. One Wildwood experience.
paragraphs: Buttercup Beauty was designed around multigenerational hosting—a place where grandparents, parents, and children can come together in Wildwood and share one experience without giving up the comfort each generation needs.

Livability guided the redesign. A large central living area gives the whole family room to gather, while multiple seating moments and thoughtful design elements create places to connect throughout the home. Every decision was made to help a large family settle in naturally, spend meaningful time together, and leave with a shared collection of Wildwood memories.

buttercup-beauty.accessibility: Guests climb a few stairs at the entrance. Please contact us before booking to discuss specific accessibility needs.

central-ave-socialization.shortDescription: A relaxed North Wildwood shore house with a heated private pool, hot tub, and easy beach access.
central-ave-socialization.fullDescription: Central Ave Socialization is a recently renovated group retreat built around easy time together. An open living area and fully fenced backyard create a welcoming home base for beach days, pool time, and evenings with the whole crew—including dogs.
uniqueFeatures: Approximately a five-minute walk to Albert I. Allen Memorial Park
Heated private pool and hot tub in a fully fenced backyard
Seven bedrooms and eighteen listed beds for large-group stays

designerNote.headline: Made for gathering. Designed to feel lived in.
paragraphs: Central Ave Socialization was designed around hosting events and giving large groups multiple living areas where they can come together. The goal was a home that felt genuinely lived in—not another sterile vacation rental.

That meant choosing extremely comfortable oversized couches, adding blackout shades in every bedroom, and selecting artwork that entertains as much as it decorates. Every space is intended to help a full house settle in, connect, and feel at home together.

central-ave-socialization.accessibility: Please contact us before booking to discuss specific accessibility needs.

the-shamrock.shortDescription: A colorful Wildwood original, made for milestone weekends and the whole crew.
the-shamrock.fullDescription: Big groups deserve a home with just as much personality. The Shamrock brings everyone together in a restored piece of Wildwood history, with generous shared spaces and a location close to the beach, boardwalk, and downtown.
uniqueFeatures: A restored piece of the historic Shamrock property
Ten bedrooms, four living rooms, and two decks
Garage and driveway parking for eight cars

designerNote.headline: A Wildwood original, carried forward.
paragraphs: The Shamrock is part of Wildwood history. The Shamrock Bar & Grill is the oldest bar and grill in Wildwood, and the house itself was moved from a block away rather than torn down—preserving a piece of that history for what came next.

We wanted the home to retain as much of its historic charm as possible while still introducing a point of view of our own. The result is an intentional mix of old and new. Rooms such as Marilyn Monroe and Motorcycle preserve much of the historic house’s look and spirit, while Puppy Love and Mermaid were transformed more dramatically.
Across every room, the goal remained the same: create a distinct experience with a personality guests would remember, just like The Shamrock itself.
